headline: Peninsula Energy says a cybersecurity incident hit the control systems at its Wyoming uranium project, which remains shut down.
summary: New incident page. Peninsula's two ASX filings (s002, Nov 23 trading halt; s001, Nov 25 update) say a cybersecurity incident affected the plant and wellfield operating and control systems at Lance on Nov 20, that the breach was to its operating system only, and that operations are suspended with no restart date. The company never says attack, so the main answer follows outlets calling it a cyberattack (The Register, Cowboy State Daily): Reported, filed under hack-reported. incident_type attack; service down on c003 (Confirmed, Tier 1). Size Local: one site, corporate systems unaffected by the company's account. Wyoming DEQ's comment and an adviser's outsider-or-insider remark are Reported through Cowboy State Daily. Theory sweep: one Hacker News post with no comments; Reddit not read. Picture: an NRC public-domain photograph of another company's Wyoming in-situ recovery site, captioned as not involved; the small copy was scaled from the 1920-pixel file. Privacy check done: no staff, reporters or private people named.
